title: v0.6.5 BOSCH raw OES upload-to-report template
status: Planning only; implementation must be triggered separately
implementation_scope: Isolated local deployment only; no changes to the actual Sherpa checkout, external deployment, publishing, merging or dependency upgrades.
outcome: A scientist uploads original BOSCH files, reviews SHA-bound interpretation and step selections, discovers and reviews peak definitions, measures all eligible original acquisitions, and generates a retained report of per-wafer critical-step median intensities by DOE conditions without developer scripts.

local_additions_to_preserve: Exact acquisition snapshot portfolios and data.portfolio_spectra
Reviewed phase boundaries, transition retention and relative frame overrides
Simplified step table and matched-transition selection
Identical selection in comparison and wavelength trace, wavelength grid arrows
Bounded canvas rendering for all selected spectra and crash fixes
Raw-count peak workflow and exported exact source reconstruction
UVSpectra10 local retirement and explicit stale-binding errors
reuse.note: PR metadata rechecked 2026-11-15: both PRs remain open. Their remote heads predate later local changes. Reconcile, do not replace the local archive with a PR checkout.

required: Selected original Day_*.nc daily OES files
SHA-pinned OES/process decoding dictionaries, reusing bundled verified bytes when applicable
Minimum versioned recipe/phase and day/lot DOE context, reusing the reviewed BOSCH preset when applicable
Versioned public or user-provided emission references with citations and coordinate conventions
optional: User-reviewed mapping, phase boundary and assignment revisions
excluded: Microscopy, images, etch depth/rate or uniformity modeling
A requirement to upload the entire Zenodo archive
Eigenvector adapter implementation in the BOSCH acceptance gate
Private hosted OES assignment code or reference-library copying

scientific_contract.discovery: Reuse analysis.peak_finding on bounded representative raw spectra. Height 200 counts and +1.2 nm relative shift are editable BOSCH choices, never universal defaults. Discovery threshold does not filter the quantification population.
scientific_contract.quantification: Freeze PeakDefinitionSet with unique IDs, raw/corrected wavelength coordinates, explicit channel/window or molecular band, units, background treatment and reference revision. Measure every eligible original acquisition, including values below the discovery cutoff. Preserve invalid/missing/nondetected/zero as distinct states.
scientific_contract.statistic: Primary: acquisition-weighted median of per-frame peak-window heights (or declared fixed channel / band metric), separately per day/lot, wafer, phase, channel and peak. Retain Q1, Q3, eligible/valid/excluded counts, detection rate, episode/cycle coverage and the weighting rule. Exact results must not depend on batching; no median of batch medians.
distinctions: A peak on a median spectrum is not the median of per-acquisition peak heights.
Existing PeakFinding median_height is conditional on detected constituent peaks.
SNV/smoothed responses must not be reported as raw counts.
Molecular-band area requires its own units and must not be mislabeled counts.
scientific_contract.doe: Keep acquisition -> cycle/episode -> wafer -> lot/day -> condition nesting. Conditioning is a chamber/lot treatment; frames are not independent treatment replicates. Show lot summaries, observed cells and missing cells without unsupported causal claims.
scientific_contract.known_design: Reviewed preset: 10 lots, 96 recorded wafers across catalog dates, not necessarily all uploaded. Blank SiO2 has only 3 repetitions recorded; do not invent 1/9 cells. Do not infer a gas-number/species map from chemistry or assign endpoint-cleaning identity to unlabeled RF intervals.
scientific_contract.assignment: Separate detection, measurement, reference candidate match, scientist approval and explanatory prose. Retain alternatives and unassigned peaks. Nearest wavelength plus recipe context is insufficient for certainty; retain atomic/molecular distinctions, citations and wavelength convention.
scientific_contract.population: Account for every acquisition as a stable, transient, no-emission or unresolved interval. Preserve transition signal. Boundary overrides create revisions and invalidate dependent results; snapshot and full-interval modes are explicit.

reuse: Native BOSCH reader/registry and typed collection/sample-table identities
Existing Report store, retained runs, export/report-data and artifact storage
Existing upload, template wizard, scoped-request and cancellation infrastructure
proposed_operations: Keyed DOE attachment through typed sample-table authority
Relative wavelength mapping with retained original axis and anchor evidence
new_contracts: Compact per-acquisition PeakMeasurements with source/sample/acquisition/episode IDs
Grouped PeakSummary with counts, coverage and weighting
Retained OES report sections and checksummed export artifacts
rules: Inspect existing registry and typed contracts before naming or adding operations; reuse or extend canonical owners rather than duplicating scientific calculations in services or UI.
Report consumes retained node results; it must not recompute peaks, retrieve hardcoded sample IDs or reconstruct originals from bounded JSON previews.
Stream full-interval extraction in bounded batches; retain compact measurements and checksummed source pointers rather than full-day spectra in browser memory.
Ordinary Local mode must work offline using public/user references; private Demo/Pro assignment remains optional and private.

ui_journey: Choose BOSCH raw OES template in a clean project or use existing uploaded files in the same project.
Upload selected daily files and process companion; display computed SHA-256 and validate optional expected hashes before admission. Review reused dictionary/context hashes.
Review day/wafer/step table in acquisition sequence. Choose critical stable steps, optionally transitions/no-emission; preserve easy relative frame overrides.
Choose Preview snapshot or Full selected intervals explicitly; retain begin/middle/end preview without silently substituting it for full population.
Discover peaks in raw counts, inspect representative spectra, review peak windows, relative wavelength correction and atomic/band definitions.
Review DOE mapping, intensity metric, weighting and reference candidates; save scientist assignments as a new revision.
Run the canonical workflow with progress, cancellation and actionable error recovery.
Open the retained Report with per-wafer peak median/IQR/counts/coverage and lot/condition comparisons, assignment evidence, provenance and limits.
Export source manifest, definitions, acquisition-level compact measurements, grouped summaries, assignment review and human-readable report. Reopen after restart without scripts.

work_orders.title: Reconcile the release baseline
work_orders.change: Inventory PR #156 / #1358, the later local nine-spectrum changes, reviewed segmentation/overrides and all report scripts. Resolve branch conflicts and reconcile shared/public blobs without changing historical qualification receipts. Preserve the isolated local deployment; no git reset or wholesale replacement with the older PR head. Record exact reconciled source identities.
work_orders.acceptance: A pinned candidate contains all authorized behavior; preservation tests pass; no local-only scientific algorithm is mislabeled released.

work_orders.title: Retire UVSpectra10
work_orders.change: Remove catalog/discovery/import support, certified-dataset entries, filename-specific unit inference and packaged CSV; retain an explicit retired-binding error and external historical custody archive.
work_orders.acceptance: No supported template/catalog advertises UVSpectra10; stale binding fails clearly; generic CSV works; historical evidence remains unchanged. Local removal completed; paired release work remains.

work_orders.title: Upload manifest and study context
work_orders.change: Reuse native ingestion and registered user-acquired imports. Compute SHA-256 on received bytes; accept optional expected SHA/manifest and fail on mismatch. Pin process companions, dictionaries, DOE/recipe files, references and parser/schema versions. Validate typed wavelength units, response units and channel blocks.
work_orders.acceptance: Clean project → upload original files → review hashes and interpretation → immutable admitted source. Changed byte or missing required companion fails before analysis. SHA proves byte identity, not instrument custody or valid labeling.

work_orders.title: Versioned DOE metadata binding
work_orders.change: Extend typed sample-table / collection-definition authority with a keyed condition attachment operation; do not introduce free-form parallel identity. Join day/lot/wafer using source-scoped keys; retain planned and actual factors, units, source cells and mapping hash.
work_orders.acceptance: Reordered rows yield identical joins; missing, ambiguous or duplicate joins fail; overrides create a new revision. Imported conditioning-surface/repetition values appear in peak rows and report.

work_orders.title: Reusable recorded-interval selection
work_orders.change: Reuse preprocess.bosch_phase_labels and reviewed boundary receipts. Bind clock alignment, source labels, overrides, transition retention, exclusion reasons and frame/time coverage to the workflow. Explicitly choose Preview snapshot or Full selected intervals.
work_orders.acceptance: Every acquisition is accounted for exactly once, including transitions/unmapped/no-emission; snapshot stays exactly nine, full selection expands only by explicit choice; boundary edits invalidate dependent results.

work_orders.title: Peak discovery and wavelength mapping
work_orders.change: Keep analysis.peak_finding unchanged as the detector; run on bounded representative spectra per phase/channel block. Add a generic relative wavelength-map operation with explicit manual or validated-anchor mode; retain original coordinates and anchor evidence. Freeze a peak/band measurement definition after review.
work_orders.acceptance: Measured and corrected axes are distinct; nm/Å and air/vacuum conventions are declared; insufficient or contradictory anchors do not apply a shift; +1.2 nm is a BOSCH preset decision, never a universal default.

work_orders.title: Canonical full-population peak measurement
work_orders.change: New generic analysis.peak_measurement operation accepts pinned dense, partitioned or cube selections and a PeakDefinitionSet. Extract original-unit channel values, declared-window peak height and band area in bounded batches; reuse the existing native reader and any public numerical primitives. Refactor the private temporal helper through the public operation only by reviewed paired work.
work_orders.acceptance: Frame-level values retain source/sample/acquisition/episode IDs, windows, background treatment and quality flags. Monolithic/chunked results match; no max-over-unrelated-channel block, peak merging across detectors, full-day Plotly materialization, silent downsampling or normalized-as-counts output.

work_orders.title: Canonical grouped intensity statistics
work_orders.change: New stats.grouped_peak_summary reducer over measured peak features: wafer/phase/channel/peak summaries, optional cycle-balanced mode, then nested lot/condition summaries. Publish statistic name, weighting, median, quartiles, valid/excluded/eligible counts, detection rate and coverage.
work_orders.acceptance: Detect-then-median is distinguished from peak-on-median-spectrum. Below-200 observations remain measurable; nondetection, invalid and missing are distinct. Exact medians are independent of chunk size; no median-of-batch-medians. Frame counts never masquerade as independent DOE replication.

work_orders.title: Local reference matching and scientist review
work_orders.change: Add a generic canonical analysis.spectral_line_match operation accepting a user-supplied/reviewed versioned reference table, plus a persisted scientist assignment review revision. Keep detection, quantification, assignment and prose separate. Represent molecular bands separately from atomic lines and preserve alternatives/unassigned groups.
work_orders.acceptance: Normal Local runs offline from public/user references and retains citations, reference hash, coordinate convention, ion stage when supported, electronic/vibrational assignments when supplied and explicit evidence status. No automatic species certainty from nearest wavelength or chemistry alone.
work_orders.owner: OSS generic operation; private hosted interpreter optional

work_orders.title: Report from retained evidence
work_orders.change: Extend the existing Report store/export/report-data path and artifact renderer with OES summary and DOE sections. Consume typed PeakMeasurements, PeakSummary and AssignmentReview results. Include raw spectra/compact features as checksummed artifacts, not JSON preview reconstructions.
work_orders.acceptance: Fresh/reopened report matches run and CSV values after restart. Every claim links to retained result + reviewed source; data/preprocessing/assignment revisions trigger stale status. No hardcoded sample IDs, 200 threshold, +1.2 offset, static manifest or external Python script needed.

work_orders.title: Publish the actual template
work_orders.change: Register OES critical-step peak intensities by condition with a BOSCH preset. Reuse the existing wizard, immutable dataset selection, typed template bindings and canonical nodes. Expose one compact setup: source, phases, factors, peak library, response metric, aggregation and report.
work_orders.acceptance: A scientist starts from Upload and reaches a retained report without a developer or edited scripts. Exploration/SNV is an optional parallel branch and never feeds the primary counts report. User reviews uncertain mapping/assignment results without handling implementation details.

work_orders.title: Eigenvector native time-series/channel adapter
work_orders.change: Use the native MATLAB process-log cube, not the time-averaged catalog projection, for phase medians. Preserve 129 feature identities / 43 distinct coordinate values as declared channel blocks; establish their source meaning before splitting or combining. Bind units from verified metadata and interval labels from a documented source. Match MACHINE/RFM by wafer IDs, never row index.
work_orders.acceptance: Real uploaded OES_DATA.mat plus declared companions replays end to end; variable-length padding is excluded, time-point indices are not invented seconds, duplicate wavelengths are not averaged as presumed replicates, 126 OES vs 129 machine wafers are reconciled explicitly. Whole-interval summaries remain possible when phase metadata is absent.

work_orders.title: Qualification and release evidence
work_orders.change: Add numerical semantic tests, clean-project browser journeys, original-source replay, bounded-memory/cancel/stale-response checks, generated-contract checks, pinned runtime validation and paired source reconciliation. Preserve private/public boundaries.
work_orders.acceptance: BOSCH clean upload -> full intervals -> per-wafer medians -> DOE report passes on the actual isolated candidate. Scope tests, generated contracts and local browser/build checks are fresh. Any paired PR/release work and unexecuted platform gates are recorded separately; Eigenvector is deferred.

acceptance_tests.test: Clean-project UI upload of original Day and Process files -> SHA review -> template -> full selected intervals -> canonical measurements -> retained DOE report; no terminal, edited script or manual database write.
Expected SHA mismatch, changed source bytes, missing companion, changed dictionary, ambiguous DOE join or missing required units fail before admitting scientific output; original files remain intact.
Reordered DOE rows give identical keyed attachment; duplicate/missing joins fail. Override revisions alter pins and mark dependent reports stale.

Every original acquisition has exactly one recorded-interval assignment; boundary shifts preserve transition signal. Begin/middle/end snapshot stays exact; full intervals include every eligible frame with no silent downsampling.

Numerical controls distinguish median(frame maxima) from max(median spectrum) and above-threshold conditional medians from all-frame medians. Include below-200, zero, missing and invalid measurements.

Chunked and monolithic extraction match exact measurements, counts, medians and quantiles; cycle-balanced alternate is explicitly named. Verify individual values against native reader, including interval boundaries.

Check original/corrected axes, units and air/vacuum declarations; reject contradictory anchors and ambiguous windows; molecular bands retain distinct definitions and units. Review does not promote a candidate to certain merely because it is nearest.

Full selected intervals across multiple days run with bounded backend/browser memory, cancellation and stale-request protection. Changing selection during work cannot display an old result as current.

Report and exported CSV/JSON values match retained results after application restart; full-resolution originals/compact measurements come from pinned artifacts, never bounded graph previews. Invalidated revisions show stale status.

Existing exact nine-spectrum saved comparison, matched transitions, all-spectra rendering, wavelength arrows and existing unrelated workflows still work. UVSpectra10 remains absent with clear legacy-binding errors.

Data table and plots verified independently in-browser; include scientific source/workflow/node/port identities and actual outcome in fresh evidence. Run scoped Python/frontend checks, production build, generated-contract checks and make evidence-check; report unexecuted platform/release coverage honestly.

handoff.first_step: Read AGENTS.md, docs/AUTHORITIES.md and repository governance. Inventory PR heads and later local changes before editing. Start in isolated archive; do not alter actual Sherpa checkout.
handoff.eigenvector: Preserve generic extensibility, but defer real MATLAB channel/time/phase adapter qualification to follow-up. It must not delay or masquerade as completed BOSCH functionality.
handoff.delivery: Demonstrate the local upload-to-report journey in-app and leave a usable template and retained report at port 8012. No external merge/deploy or release qualification is implied.
handoff.verification_status: This PR is a plan. Historical local checks and audit probes do not qualify unimplemented nodes or the future template.
